create_fine_tuning_job_async: create an async fine-tuning job using litellm with a specified model and training file
list_fine_tuning_jobs: list fine-tuning jobs with optional limit and after parameters via litellm async API
cancel_fine_tuning_job: cancel an existing fine-tuning job by its job ID using litellm async cancel method
convert_openai_to_vertex_request: convert an OpenAI fine-tuning job request to a Vertex AI compatible request format
create_azure_fine_tuning_job: create an Azure fine-tuning job with custom training type and hyperparameters via litellm
